<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Compose Trigger and Content under Root. Item can handle select. Use CheckboxGroup and RadioGroup when State needs to retain a choice.

## Usage

```ts
import { dropdownMenu, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/dropdown-menu';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/dropdown-menu`. It [registers](../../registration/) 17 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.DropdownMenu>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
